title: Campaigns
markdown:
Campaigns are instances of cyber criminals attempting a harmful intent as identified through sets of Incidents, Malware, Vulnerabilities exploited and identified Tactics, Techniques and Procedures (TTPs) of Threat Actors. CFTR allows you to create, manage, and connect cyber threat Campaigns with Incidents, Vulnerabilities, Threat Briefings, Threat Actors, and Malware to gather improved Threat Intelligence using data fusion. CFTR provides a solution that helps the security teams respond effectively to cyber Campaigns targeting your organization.

This section describes how to use the API endpoints to manage the Campaigns.
